74HC595.name: 74HC595

model.note: Clocked digital model: outputs are 50 ohm switches to Vcc/GND, inputs switch at Vcc/2, unpowered (below 2 V) the chip forgets its state. State advances once per time step, so outputs change one step after the clock edge. Use the time graph with a clock source. SHCP shifts DS in on its rising edge; STCP copies the shift register to the outputs on its rising edge; ~OE high floats Q0-Q7; ~MR clears the shift register. Q7S is the serial output of the shift register.
